notes.title: February Content Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35301153/2f3ce59ebc8d52a914e72c06decf55ccb0367e7e.jpg[/img]

The February update has arrived - apologies for cutting it a bit close! My Windows laptop had a battery swelling issue and I wasn't comfortable shipping an update unless I could standy to fix any Windows issues that came up. The good news is that I'm back online now!

This update features a new enemy that will show up in the final dungeon - Cococat! Cococat was one of the deadliest and most hated enemies in the original Meteorfall: Journeys game. In Krumit's Tale, in addition to having deadly quick and piercing attacks, Cococat also punishes you on the board by causing tiles in the same row to require health to pick up.

Rounding out the update are a couple new abilities, and a new perk, Magician, that adds a 'Push' action to all of your abilities that target enemies. It can be a difficult perk to make use of, but can be used to inflict more damage with burn as Greybeard, help trigger traps as Varfa, or isolate enemies as Mischief.

NEW

New Enemy: Cococat
"Acquiring a tile in the same row costs 2 health"

New Ability: Humility (Rose), 0 cost
"Instant. Restore 8 health and Repent. Can only be acquired if you have 0 gold

New Ability: Trick Shot (Varfa), 2 cost
"Deal 8 piercing damage, split among enemies in the same row. Exhaust"

New Perk: Magician (Greybeard, Mischief, Varfa)
"When you target an enemy with an item or ability, also Push them"

BUG FIXES
- #1617: Removed Stout from the Endless mutation
- #1641: The cost of Frenzy no longer shows up as '99'
- #1643: Battle Song now requires that there's a visible weapon
- #1645: Damage dealt by Healing Trap now works properly with Mark
- #XXXX: Arcanist no longer triggers when removing Curse tiles (including Megaton)
- #XXXX: Fix a bug where block was not removed for some enemies, after defeating a hero's minions

notes.title: The January Content Update
notes.content:
[h1]The January Content Update[/h1]
We're back from holiday and have some exciting new updates for Krumit's Tale!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35301153/cbba002c098b81e9f944513e0d593ca5e345a9c2.png[/img]

[h2]Krumit can now speak Chinese![/h2]
We partnered with out publisher, Indienova, to add a world class Chinese localization of all Krumit's lines! After listening to Krumit in English for the past couple years, it was a bit surreal (and awesome!) to hear him speak Chinese. You can check out the Chinese VO in-game by language in-game to Simplfied Chinese.

[h2]NG+9 Now Available[/h2]
Some of the most skilled players have blazed through New Game+8 and have been asking for a new challenge. This update introduces NG+9, which adds an additional modifier. The final NG+ level, NG+10, will be added in a future update.

We've also rebalanced the earlier NG+ levels which add curses. Those NG+ levels will add curses to your deck in the 2nd and 3rd dungeon respectively, to make the first dungeon less punishing due to bad RNG.

[h2]New Tiles[/h2]
We're also adding 4 brand new tiles to the game

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35301153/180ffbd7ee29c3d63a5805e2442ab62a71ce62fc.png[/img]

[b]New Weapon: Snowpiercer[/b] (Greybeard): 1 cost, 2 durability, 3 damage 
[i]“Piercing when attacking Frozen opponents”[/i]

[b]New Trap: Healing Trap[/b] (Varfa, Muldorf)
"Pay 2 gold to arm this trap. Trigger: Deal 6 piercing damage split between enemies in the same row, [i]and restore 6 health split between you and your minions"[/i]

[b]New Armor: Widow's Grasp[/b] (Bruno, Muldorf): 3 cost, 3 durability, 4 block
[i]“When you parry, add a copy of Spider Bite to your inventory”[/i]

[b]New Ability: Kick[/b] (Mischief) 1 gold
[i]"Deal 8 damage to an enemy and push them. Can't be used in battle. Exhaust"[/i]

[h2]Balance Changes & Full Patch Notes[/h2]
We've also added some balance changes and reworks for some underused (or hard to use) tiles. Please see all the changes in the full patch notes below. We hope you enjoy the update!

[b]NEW[/b]
[list]
[*] Krumit can now speak in Chinese! (Check it out by setting your language to Chinese in the Settings)
[*] NG+9 (You have one less choice when choosing perks and treasure)
[*]New Tiles: Snowpiercer, Widow's Grasp, Healing Trap, Kick
[/list]

[h3]MISCELLANEOUS CHANGES[/h3]
[list]
[*] Daily Challenge now accepts only the first score (you can play as many times as you like though)
[/list]

[h3]BALANCE: ENDESS[/h3]
[list]
[*] Removed items and abilities that increase base attack (only in the Daily Challenge version of Endless). 
[*] Enemy ratios skewed towards more powerful enemies.
[/list]

[h3]BALANCE: NG+[/h3]
[list]
[*] NG+ levels that add curses now do so on the 2nd and 3rd dungeons respectively, instead of in the 1st dungeon
[/list]

[h3]BALANCE: BRUNO[/h3]
[olist]
[*] Smashgud reworked: Damage 6->5, Now reads "Your attack stuns"
[*] Slam reworked: Deal 10 damage to an enemy, cost 3->2
[*] Sharpen is now Instant
[/olist]

[h3]BALANCE: ROSE[/h3]
[list]
[*] Renounce: Now Cycles when acquired
[*] Shadow Crown reworked: Cost 3->4, Now reads "Restore 1 durability when a corrupted enemy dies"
[*] Bat King's Mantle reworked: Now reads "While you block with this item, you have thorns equal to the number of visible curses"
[*] Penance reworked: Now reads "When you acquire this and when you have depleted it, repent", Damage 5->6
[/list]

[h3]BALANCE: GREYBEARD[/h3]
[list]
[*] Dragorn's Paw reworked: Cost 4->3, now reads "Attack increased by the number of burn stacks on your opponent"
[*] Shatter: Cost 2->1, Recharge 8 rounds in battle->2, Damage 4->3
[*] Meditate is now Instant, Cost 2->1
[/list]
 
[h3]BALANCE: MISCHIEF[/h3]
[list]
[*] Hide is now Instant, and Cycles
[*] 
[/list]
[h3]BUGS[/h3]
[list]
[*] #1573: Instant tiles are now acquirable even if your inventory is full
[*] #1576: Stoopid no longer 'consumes' Street Rat
[*] #1582: Fixed an issue which made it impossible to remove Stoopid in some cases
[*] #1595: Queen's Grail no longer spawns in Endless
[*] #1600: Blast Wave no longer glitches when used in battle against a bottom row enemy
[*] #1612: Seek no longer glitches when duplicated with Poet
[*] #XXXX: Counterfeit no longer duplicates 'perk gifts' in Endless
[*] #XXXX: Seek no longer targets / glitches when it selects a 'perk gift' in Endless
[/list]

notes.title: Holiday Content Update
notes.content:
Hi folks! We're back with another content update to celebrate the holidays!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35301153/a9c56ce9f3a140d5553dfd1bfc4812330b515182.png[/img]

[h2]New Mutation: Endless[/h2]
In this new mutation, you fight through a single dungeon, surviving as long as you can. As you defeat more and more enemies, stronger enemies will begin to spawn. 'Gift' tiles will also spawn, allowing you to draft a perk mid-dungeon. How long can you survive before you're overwhelmed by a board full of bosses?

[h2]New items: Wishing Lamp & Frost Trap[/h2]
We're also adding two brand new items!

[h3]Frost Trap[/h3]
[i]Varfa, Greybeard[/i]
Pay 1 coin to arm this trap. Trigger: Apply freeze to enemies in the same row

[h3]Wishing Lamp[/h3]
[i]Neutral[/i]
Choose: Gain 1 coin, restore 3 health, or restore 1 durability to a random item in your inventory

[h2]New perk: Battlemage[/h2]

[h3]Battlemage[/h3]
[i]Greybeard[/i]
When you burn or freeze an enemy, reduce the cost of weapons in the same row by 2

[h3]We hope you enjoy this brand new content update, and have a safe & warm holiday season![/h3]

notes.title: November Content Update
notes.content:
With Varfa out, the team has been focused on expanding out Krumit's Tale with free content update. The first update we have adds the following new features:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35301153/88cb7006b66192e1c14fed878ce0dba79f0d589b.png[/img]

[h2]New Mutation: Baron[/h2]
In this Mutation, you start out with the Privileged and Greedy perks, and gold carries over between dungeons. You'll amass a huge fortune of gold - but achieving the top score will require careful management of your resources.

Baron can be accessed when starting a new run in the Mutation menu, and will occasionally show up during the daily challenge.

We're also adding two new perks:

[h3]Fencer[/h3] (Bruno, Rose)
When you [u]parry[/u] an attack, restore 2 health

[h3]Bandit[/h3] (All heroes)
Your attack is increased by 1 against [u]solitary[/u] enemies but your deck size is decreased by 1

We're also adding a new potion / item called Liquid Armor

[h3]Liquid Armor[/h3] (All heroes)
Use to gain 3 [u]block[/u] this round in combat

[h2]Stay tuned![/h2]
We're already hard at work on some new items and a new Mutation for December. We hope you enjoy this new update, and be sure to let us know what you think!

notes.title: Varfa DLC - Now Available!
notes.content:
Hi folks! Super excited to announce new DLC for Krumit's Tale is now available! I'm rerunning a post from earlier about some details of what the DLC includes, along with some FAQ - check it out!

____________________________

We're excited to announce new DLC for Meteorfall: Krumit's Tale! This new DLC adds a brand new hero: Varfa the Ranger & her loyal companion, Orhu. Includes are more than 50 new items & abilities, several new perks, and a bunch of  brand new gameplay mechanics.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35301153/c6f1fd11370d201cf285c9c2e7dbb686fd5a11fb.png[/img]

[h2]Your Loyal Companion[/h2]
With Varfa, we wanted to introduce a new type of minion to better reflect the unique capabilities of Orhu. Orhu works similarly to Muldorf's skeletal minions, but also has his own set of abilities. You can pay gold to unlock 3 tiers of abilities for Orhu.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35301153/fbfec2b4b3cc33ff690ec54f9b13dbd9ab87d9bb.png[/img]
All of Orhu's abilities recharge after a certain number of rounds of combat. Depending on your playstyle and the deck you're building, you might choose to unlock different abilities for Orhu. For instance, some of Orhu's abilities add extra damage; others stun or block. 

[h2]Traps[/h2]
Traps are a type of new tile in the Varfa DLC update. Traps are items that stay on the board, but can be 'armed' by paying their gold cost. Armed traps can later be triggered if enemies move into the same row as the trap (or if the trap is dropped down into the same row as an enemy)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35301153/e614f9fcec436fd6a741b2d19280872790a5cb9a.png[/img]

Using traps effectively requires you to master ways to manipulate the position of tiles on the board, leading to a very unique and interesting playstyle when investing heavily into traps. You can also make use of a new keyword 'Push' to push enemy tiles up on the board and trigger traps that way. 

[h2]Hunt your Enemies[/h2]

In the Varfa update, you'll be able to 'Mark' your enemies using a variety of new items and abilities. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35301153/1b5275017d7e5cc50156d6ee67da8c4b38bca3bc.png[/img]

Marked enemies take additional damage from 'out of combat' abilities, such as Varfa's Quickshot or the Hunting Rifle. Compared to melee oriented heroes like Bruno and Mischief, Varfa excels at dealing damage outside of battle with ranged weapons and abilities. Marking your enemies gives your ranged arsenal a bit of extra power.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35301153/318c6a928c532dc9061c132287a759e52e489786.png[/img]

[h2]FAQ[/h2]

[b]When will the DLC release?[/b]
October 21

[b]How much will the DLC cost?[/b]
The DLC will cost $1.99 USD (may be adjusted depending on your local currency)

[b]What about Daily Challenges?[/b]
All players will have access to Varfa when she appears during a daily challenge, regardless of whether they own the DLC or not. It's a great chance to try her out if you're on the fence about buying the DLC!

[b]What about the Epic Edition of the game?[/b]
We'll also be adding the Varfa DLC retroactively for all owners of the Krumit's Tale Epic edition (which currently just includes the sound track). Thank you for your support!

[h2]Answer the Call![/h2]
Besides the Varfa DLC, we're continuing to work on free updates as well - new items, abilities, perks and mutations. Keep an eye out for more about this soon.

notes.title: Beware the Reaper's Curse!
notes.content:
We've prepared our spookiest update yet and are introducing a brand new Mutation mode called "Reaper's Curse"! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35301153/0916677670f0a3221a2e47f7c33a1b1b014534ee.png[/img]

It's available immediately for all players and can be accessed when you start a new 'Mutation Mode' game. It'll also come up periodically during the daily challenge, including an extra spooky challenge on Halloween (Oct 31) where the Reaper's Curse is guaranteed to show up.

[h2]How does it work?[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35301153/6a5c60e1a254d342fc73a8bd6c1ec75dc6699701.png[/img]

Fight monsters and acquire items & abilities as normals. At some point, stairs to the next floor will be revealed and you can proceed up to the next level - or, you can stick around on the floor for a bit, acquiring tiles or fighting enemies. However, once the stairs are revealed, copies of Reaper's Curse are shuffled into the deck. While on the board, your max health is reduced for each copy; however, you'll also be awarded more points. It's dangerous to keep them around, but it's also how to achieve the highest score.

As you ascend 7 floors to the top of the Haunted Spire to face the Ghost King, you'll face more and more difficult enemies. Hopefully you're well prepared with items and abilities to face the Ghost King when he appears on the top of the 7th floor!

It only takes 10 minutes to finish a complete round of Reaper's Curse, so it's great if you're looking for a quicker game mode.

We hope you enjoy this new content, and stay tuned for the Varfa DLC coming later this month, with additional free content coming after that!

notes.title: [BETA] Rose Perk Rework + New Tiles
notes.content:
These changes are out today on the beta branch so that we can test them out, and will be on the default branch in the coming weeks.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35301153/9ed4c377280189f34c28449b291e0425b61ff562.png[/img]

[h2]Rose's Starting Perk[/h2]
Rose's starting perk, which converts visible curses on the board into blessings, has proven more difficult than expected to use. While we feel good about her Queen of Shadow perk (corrupt enemies you attack), Rose 'Chosen' perk doesn't feel very impactful.

[b]In this update, we're reworking Rose's Chosen perk to read:[/b]

[i]When you remove or transform a visible curse, deal 2 piercing damage to enemies in the same row[/i]

Effectively, the playing as Queen creates a bunch of dangerous waste (curses) on the board and it's up to Rose to clean it up. Removing a curse can be done through removing the curse (by paying the health cost) or by using any other card that transforms or removes curses (such as Demonic Chest or Kiki's Bow) 

[h2]New Keyword: Repent[/h2]
Another way to remove curses is with the [u]Repent[/u] keyword, which is new in this update and featured on two of Rose's tiles.

[u]Repent[/u]: If a curse is present on the board, trigger this tile's effect. Then, convert the curse into a blessing

Two of Rose's new tiles feature the keyword [u]Repent[/u]. To use these tiles effectively (or to get more out of them), you need to have curses on board to use as resources. 

[h2]New Items and Abilities[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35301153/efd8bc601064c11b88b7f9a719132815d59dac2c.png[/img]

[h3]Holy Symbol[/h3]
Deal 2 piercing damage to visible enemies. Repent: Repeat this effect

[i]This item deals up to 4 damage to all visible enemies, if you have a curse on board. If you play your cards right, you can deal 2 extra damage to one of the rows, because Repent trigger's Chosen as well, since it removes a curse[/i]

[h3]Vigilance[/h3]
Repent: Gain 3 block this round (while in battle)

[i]This item allows you to convert curses on the board into useful block. This triggers Rose's new Chosen perk and also helps convert curses into more useful blessings[/i]

[h3]Judgmental Blade[/h3]
When you acquire this, shuffle 5 curses into the deck. Depleted: Gain 1 gold for each visible curse

notes.title: Introducing 'Explorer Mode' (Beta Branch)
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35301153/8304831ee0613bf493680c5bd106dc9198abc319.png[/img]

[b]A new, easier & more accessible mode is now live on the beta branch and will roll out to the default branch in the next couple weeks.[/b]

[h2]Is Krumit's Tale Too Difficult?[/h2]
When I set out to design Krumit's Tale, I wanted to design a 'deeper' game than my previous game, Meteorfall: Journeys, while still retaining the accessibility that made the first game popular. While I succeeded on the 'deeper' part, I didn't quite succeed on the 'accessible' part. Early feedback from mobile reviewers and some long-time feedback on the Steam forums has made it clear - Krumit's Tale is too difficult for some folks.

For a game designer, difficulty can be extremely challenging to get right. Too easy, and people beat the game on their first try and get bored quickly. Too difficult and many players just bounce off of the game, frustrated and upset. One of the number one reasons folks that have refunded on Steam gave is 'too hard', and that's reflected in many of the negative reviews.

Some time during Early Access, I added an 'Easy Mode' mutation but feedback I got on that from multiple people was that it didn't quite hit the mark and still felt too difficult. It was also buried under the Mutation Mode menu, meaning some folks couldn't find it.

[h2]Introducing 'Explorer Mode'[/h2]
I decided to introduce a third major game mode - Explorer Mode - to help folks explore all that Krumit's Tale has to offer at the difficulty level that feels most comfortable.

Below is a preview. [b]This feature is now live on the beta branch and will be rolling out to the main branch shortly thereafter[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35301153/6008306e4878eaa5de0b8fd4bc4b6ace5a7968ec.png[/img]

Choosing Explorer Mode brings up a dialog before you begin your run that allows you to pick a bunch of different buffs that help make the game easier. If you've tried the Easy Mode mutation in the past, all the buffs from Easy Mode have moved to Explorer Mode - with a bunch of new ones as well. If you just need a small boost, you can start with a little extra gold. If you want a truly easy experience to allow you to play from beginning to end, you can opt for fewer enemies and greatly reduced boss health. It's up to you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35301153/05e897d3f9ac11f38d5bed7791098faa045fb19f.png[/img]

[h2]A More Accessible Experience[/h2]
If you found Krumit's Tale too difficult or frustrating in your first playthrough, we hope you'll give it another chance when we release Explorer Mode in the coming few weeks! We really want Krumit's Tale to a game that respects your time - whether you play every day or just want to see the ending once before moving on. Explorer Mode will hopefully give people of all skill levels the ability to enjoy Krumit's Tale at their own pace.

[h2]One More Thing[/h2]
This update also brings one more hotly requested feature - faster battle animations! There's a new checkbox under Settings > Video that speeds up the battle animations significantly. This is one of the most requested QoL features and I'm excited that we were finally able to get it done!

We also fixed a bunch of other issues, and added experimental Czech and Korean support. Full patch notes below

[h3]NEW[/h3]
Brand new 'Explorer Mode' - customize the game's difficulty to your liking

[h3]IMPROVEMENTS[/h3]

[h3]BUGS[/h3]
#1121 - Fixed an issue where player's scores wouldn't show up on the Daily Challenge scoreboard until later, as well as an issue where the rank shown was one higher than it should be
#1125 - Megaton no longer triggers Blessing of Magic

notes.title: Krumit's Tale coming to Android & iOS on Aug 27!
notes.content:
[h2]Mark Your Calendar[/h2]
Hot on the heels of our Steam 1.0 release, we're getting ready to launch Krumit's Tale on Android and iOS on August 27!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35301153/ca2462e700b2fafe76eeb444f5bcfe197ffb5d8e.jpg[/img]

[h2]Where can I get it?[/h2]

[url=https://apps.apple.com/app/id1369611597][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35301153/2d3a20be00a097d101a7e3f4fbf60f718791251c.jpg[/img][/url]

[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.slothwerks.krumit&hl=en_US][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35301153/5be0f42b57d5a3f8476d751603e8092dee1c2a3b.png[/img][/url]

[h2]Can I sync my PC progress?[/h2]
Yes! Although there are many solutions like Steam Cloud, iCloud, etc... to save your progress and sync between devices on the same platform, there isn't an easy way to sync between PC <-> Mobile. We ended up building our own solution. 

To sync progress, there's an option in Settings > Last tab > Export Data. This generates a 5 digit ID. On your second device, you can go to Settings > Last tab > Import Data. This will copy over your progress form the first device (for instance a PC) to the second (eg: an iPhone or Android), allowing you to have all your heroes/tiles unlocked, as well as New Game+ levels.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35301153/108428a5aa37d8df2c90f218c75db8fd9fe99518.png[/img]

The sync isn't [i]quite[/i] the same as Steam or iCloud where data is synced constantly. Instead, this solution is optimized to copy over progress from one platform to another - for instance, if you're interested in continuing on Mobile but already unlocked all the heroes and tiles on PC. It's less ideal if you're interested in constantly switching between platforms. That said, we think based on the way unlocks and progress works in Krumit's Tale that this solution is a good answer for folks that are interested primarily in being able to carry forward their PC progress to mobile.

[h2]Which countries are supported?[/h2]
In terms of where you can download the game, you'll be able to download Krumit's Tale in all markets except Mainland China. There are some additional steps we need to take before the game is available for Chinese players, which our publishing partner, Indienova, is working with us on. In the meantime, you can follow the game on [url=https://www.taptap.com/app/195080]TapTap[/url]  

In terms of supported languages, Krumit's Tale will support all current languages in the Steam version of the game.

[h2]Does it support portrait or landscape?[/h2]
Both actually! The mobile version of Krumit's Tale is designed to be played in portrait mode. Like our previous mobile game, Meteorfall: Journeys, Krumit's Tale is designed to be played on the go while walking, commuting, etc... and portrait mode works really well for that. We do also support landscape as well - a bit small on phone but works quite well on tablet.

[h2]Sounds great! How much does it cost?[/h2]
Krumit's Tale will launch on mobile for $6.99 USD.

[h2]Screenshots[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35301153/814a1994fec6e801aaf578848ca62a0e4d317197.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35301153/35f3699f25929568c1d915f6622a06b5f0c3857b.jpg[/img]

Follow [url=https://twitter.com/slothwerks]@Slothwerks[/url] on Twitter for more updates, or join us in [url=bit.ly/krumit-discord]Discord[/url]!

notes.title: Krumit's Tale is leaving Early Access on July 23!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35301153/18179616a0b628f35f8d794044d18d03144d940c.png[/img]

[h2]It's been an amazing journey[/h2]
We're getting close to finishing up the Early Access phase for Meteorfall: Krumit's Tale! Since launching into Early Access in November 2019, we've expanded the game with three new heroes, more than 150 new cards, a Daily Challenge mode, and tons of other features and polish.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35301153/b24ed398a8af2d631b4524e93def82e543161d7b.png[/img]

[h2]A big thank you to the Krumit's Tale community![/h2]
A lot of those changes were made in large part due to the feedback from dedicated players and fans who took the time to let us know what was working well and what wasn't. One of the hardest things about being an indie developer is working really hard on a project, and having it go unnoticed or unappreciated. 

I'm happy to say that it definitely wasn't the case with Krumit's Tale! The Krumit's Tale community filed over 700 pieces of feedback on our Discord, along with numerous other posts on Steam, Reddit, and elsewhere. We enjoyed reading both the thoughtful messages about players that enjoyed the game, as well as the feedback from players with a more critical view of the game. The fact that so many people would take the time to let us know what they thought so that we could make the game better is a major part of why Krumit's Tale improved significantly during Early Access.

We're just really grateful for all the players who took a gamble on a small & weird indie game in Early Access. It's players and fans like you that helped give us the energy and support we needed to get Krumit's Tale over the finish line. Thank you!

[h2]What about Rose?[/h2]
Rose is being promoted to the main branch and is now available for all players! That means that all the launch content for the 1.0 release will be available for all players for a few weeks, as we focus on cleaning up a few remaining issues and make sure the game is as polished as possible for the post-Early Access debut.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35301153/0412ec0917306e8e55443ce967147b7877fbb1eb.png[/img]

[h2]What's after Early Access?[/h2]
Once we finish the initial 1.0 release of Krumit's Tale on Steam, we'll have our hands full for a few weeks as we prepare for the iOS / Android launch of the game on those platforms. Once those builds are live and stable, we anticipate that we'll continue periodically adding new free content to Krumit's Tale. We have a lot of ideas here, but expect to see things like new items, abilities, perks and Daily Challenge mode as free content updates after release.

Beyond that, there is a sixth character - Varfa - that we're planning to add (most likely as a DLC). Those of you that played our other game on iOS or Android (Meteorfall: Journeys) may recognize Varfa as a ranger / hunter type hero that slays enemies with both ranged weapons and her loyal companion in battle. We're still brainstorming ideas for Varfa and will definitely share more on her unique mechanics once we're further along in development.

We'll also be doing some write-ups about our experience developing Krumit's Tale as well - inspiration, iterations we tried, how it did financially, etc... If you're interested in the process and business of gamedev, keep an eye out for those posts!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35301153/06e913f42b812180e5e7ce342cc99aed13710f61.jpg[/img]

She's finally here! Rose is now available on the beta branch! In case you missed our last post, we discussed Rose's new mechanics here: https://steamcommunity.com/games/1073320/announcements/detail/2190384257594913025

[b]Want to try the beta?[/b]

Anyone can opt-in to the beta - simply follow [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1073320/discussions/0/1743391215797002872]these instructions[/url] these instructions if you're not already on the beta branch If you're already on the beta branch from from a previous release, you're all set!

As usual, we expect Rose will be on the beta branch at least 3-4 weeks before coming to the main branch. If you prefer a more stable experience, you may want to wait for the full release of Rose before trying her out.

[h2]First, a small request![/h2]
[h3]Please take a moment and leave a review[/h3]
For small games, reviews are super critical. Because small games get very few reviews and since most players don't leave reviews, even a few negative reviews can really skew a game's rating. If you enjoy the updates and haven't reviewed Krumit's Tale yet, please take just a minute to leave a review. It helps *so* much and is a huge help to the team. And if you're not completely satisfied - let us know how we can fix it! We've made a ton of improvements since launching in Early Access that came directly from players.

[h2]Adding new ways to find help in-game[/h2]
One of the things we noticed in some of the recent reviews is that because Krumit's Tale is really different from most other games out there, some players have struggled with the mechanics and found it too difficult. 

In this update, we're adding a "Get Help!" link on the main menu and in Settings to help players who might be struggling with the game, or have encountered some issue they'd like to leave feedback on. We're listening on all sorts of platforms - Steam, Reddit, Discord, Twitter, email, and QQ - so you can contact us in whichever way is most convenient if you have feedback. 

We also recently updated the following resources, which are now linked from in-game:

[list]
[*] [url=https://krumits-tale.com/getting-started/]Krumit's Tale - Beginner's Guide (English Only)[/url]
[*] [url=https://krumits-tale.com/wiki?lang=en]Wiki - English[/url]
[*] [url=https://krumits-tale.com/wiki?lang=zh-CN]Wiki - Chinese[/url]
[*] [url=https://krumits-tale.com/wiki?lang=es]Wiki - Spanish[/url]
[/list]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/R9y6QmW.png[/img]
[i]Need help? We've got you covered![/i]


[h2]Now introducing - shop reroll[/h2]

Some of the most common feedback we've gotten is that players want more ways to spend their exceed gems and they want a way to reroll the shop. In the Rose Update, we're adding a shop reroll! You can use this as a way to spend some extra gems, and it makes it slightly easier to try 'themed' builds (a fire-only build as Greybeard, for instance).

[img]https://i.imgur.com/mWpaUF8.png[/img]

It costs 5 gems to use the reroll the first time, then 10, and it finally caps at 15.  You can reroll as often as you like at 15 gems. We hope this new feature gives players a fun way to spend their extra gems, and make it feel more rewarding when you're playing well.



[h2]Breaking down scoring[/h2]
In the last major update, the Mutation Update, we introduced a new Daily Challenge mode with scores, but didn't really talk about how score is calculated. In this update, we've added a score breakdown view that you can see by tapping your score. The breakdown shows you how the score was calculated, and can be tapped at any time by tapping your score in the lower-left of the screen.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/L3lSMAA.png[/img]
[i]"Oh, so *that's* how it works!"[/i]


[h2]And a whole bunch of fixes![/h2]
As always, a big thank you to the Krumit's Tale player community, that has collectively logged dozens of bugs, feature suggestions, and really helped us to make the best game possible.

notes.title: The Mutation Update
notes.content:

notes.title: Something Wicked This Way Comes
notes.content:
Today we're pulling back the curtain on the last (but not least) fifth hero coming to Krumit's Tale before our 1.0 release - Rose!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/OdeUc7p.png[/img]

[h2]The Dual Nature of Light and Shadow[/h2]
Similar to her incarnation in the original Meteorfall, Rose is a hero that straddles the line between light and shadow. Building that type of mechanic in Krumit's Tale proved difficult. In Krumit's Tale, one of the main ways to help heroes feel unique is with their starting perk. We found that by swapping Rose's starting perk under certain conditions, we could make Rose feel very different. Swapping between her two 'forms' (Rose and Queen of Shadow) is a key part of how Rose plays.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/wqg5S72.png[/img]

[h2]Darkness Corrupts All[/h2]
One of the new keywords coming in the Rose Update is [Corrupt]. Corrupt, like Burn and Poison can be stacked on enemies. When a corrupted enemy dies, they restore health to the player equal to the number of corruption stacks. Corrupted enemies also leave behind a curse on the board. This becomes important with some of Rose's other tiles, because for Rose - curses are also a resource she can utilize.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/tDFtOHd.png[/img]
[i]Rose isn't above dabbling in the dark arts if it leads to gold and glory![/i]

[h2]Curses and Blessings[/h2]
The Rose Update also introduces a new type of tile as well - blessings. Blessing are similar to curses, in that they have a special effect while they're on the board. Blessing of Might, for instance, increases your attack against enemies that are adjacent to it. Blessing of Healing restores health to you after you defeat an adjacent enemy. After a condition is met (such as defeating an enemy), the blessing is removed.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/8A8pR5u.png[/img]
Rose has a lot of tiles that interact with curses and blessing. Some of her tiles have additional effects while a blessing is on the board. Other tiles allow Rose to convert curses directly into blessings.

[h2]Chosen vs Queen[/h2]
Various tiles swap Roses starting perk between 'Chosen' or 'Queen'

[img]https://i.imgur.com/xpbz4wD.png[/img]

[b]Chosen:[/b] [u]Overheal[/u]: Convert a [u]curse[/u] on the board into a [u]blessing[/u]
[b]Queen:[/b] Your first attack each battle applies [u]corruption[/u] (2)

'Overheal' is a new keyword that triggers an effect whenever you restore health, but have some 'leftover' because you're already at full health. While Rose has the 'Chosen' perk, overhealing will convert a curse on the board into a blessing.

As the Queen of Shadows, Rose's attack applies corruption. If you recall - the new 'corrupt' keyword causes defeated enemies to restore your health, but also causes them to leave behind a curse on the board.

As you can see, as the Queen of Shadow, Rose creates curses; as the Chosen, she converts curses into blessings. You'll need to take advantage of Rose's duality to clear more difficult dungeons.

[h2]Pushing Your Luck[/h2]
Part of playing Rose is about pushing your luck - filling the board with curses and then using her tiles to convert them into beneficial blessings instead.

One of Rose's most fun new items is the Hellfone. When you use it, it destroys all the curses on the board and summons a Cococat minion. The minion is more powerful if you're able to destroy more curses.

Another great item is The Queen's Grail. Once acquired, you can pay health to destroy *all* cards left in the deck, including bosses! The health cost is enough to kill you outright, but its reduced for each enemy you've corrupted. The board will be full of curses at that point, but at least the deck will be empty!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/kINN4Mx.png[/img]

[i]Sharur, Witch Hunter's Copotain, The Queen's Grail, and Hellfone - just a few of the amazing new tiles you'll discover as Rose[/i]

[h2]That's all folks![/h2]
That's it for now! We're [i]super[/i] excited about this update, because Rose marks the last major milestone before Krumit's Tale leaves Early Access. From here, we'll continue to balance and polish, as we march towards the official 1.0 release.

In the coming months, as the development on Rose settles, we'll be kicking off a beta test for mobile (iOS and Android) as well. Our first game, Meteorfall: Journeys, was an iOS / Android exclusive, and mobile definitely has a special place in our hearts. As mentioned before, if you end up grabbing the game on mobile, you'll be able to copy over all your progress as well. We've been trying out some tests builds and it's running *very* nicely now. We can't wait to put it in your hands as well!

Keep an eye out for the beta release of Rose soon, and let us know on the Steam forums, or on our Discord / Reddit (/r/KrumitsTale) what you think!

notes.title: Riff Raff, Street Rat... I Don't Buy That!
notes.content:
We've got a fun updated for you this week with a lot of big changes, as well as commonly requested quality-of-life improvements!

[h2]Mischief Gets Reworked[/h2]
One common feedback is that Mischief is more difficult to play than the other heroes. Most of this stems from her starting perk, Riffraff, which reduces her base attack by 1. Mischief is really fun when one-shot KO'ing enemies from stealth, but suffers quite a lot when the board is full of monsters. This has been a difficult perk for us to balance and we didn't want to disrupt the stealthy flavor of Mischief.

What we've done is added an additional rule to Mischief's starting perk that removes the base attack penalty while there are a lot of enemies on the board.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/j1QaNBH.png[/img]

[h3]Starting Perk rework[/h3][b]Riffraff[/b]
Gain [stealth] when attacking [solitary] enemies. -1 base attack unless [Overwhelmed]

[h3]New Keywords[/h3][b]Overwhelmed:[/b] This triggers when there are 6 or more enemies on the board
[b]Solitary[/b]: An enemy that's the only enemy in its row

The end result is that Mischief can still one-hit KO enemies while in an advantageous board state, but when she's overwhelmed with enemies, can shift to a stance that makes her more resilient.

We hope this change helps bring Mischief's difficult more in line with the other heroes and makes her more fun to play in difficult situations!

[h2]Poison Rework[/h2]
Not a major rework, but poison now triggers *before* you attack (applies to enemies as well). We got a lot of feedback that poison didn't seem fun or impactful as Mischief, and we think that making poison trigger before an attack can help to make it more a lot more powerful. Now when you strike a poison enemy from stealth but can't quite finish them off, they'll die to poison before they get to attack!

Let us know what you think of the change!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/8oywzQ7.png[/img]

[h2]Quality of Life Improvements[/h2]
[h3]Choose your rewards in any order[/h3]Another common feedback is that players want more knowledge of the upcoming dungeon *before* choose the tile rewards and perks. To that end, in this update, we're introducing a screen that shows info about the upcoming dungeon - including how many of each enemy type - and you can choose your rewards in any order.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/KJuFHdi.png[/img]

[h3]What's left in the dungeon deck?[/h3]Players have also asked for some way to see what tiles are remaining in the deck while in the dungeon. When tapping the 'next tile' preview to see the description of the next tile, we've added a 'deck' button in the lower right. Tapping that will allow you to see all the tiles still in the deck, which should hopefully allow players to better plan their strategy for completing the dungeon.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/RatELqr.png[/img]

[h2]That's it - for now![/h2]
That's all we have for now! We're listening to Steam, Reddit, Discord, etc... for your feedback on all these changes, and other ideas for improvements. If you have some ideas, don't hesitate to share!

[h2]Full Patch Notes[/h2]
[h3]MAJOR REWORKS[/h3][list][*] Poison now triggers at the beginning of the turn in battle, rather than the end
[*] Mischief starting perk rework. Riffraff now reads 'Gain #stealth when attacking #solitary enemies. -1 base attack unless #Overwhelmed'[/list]

[h3]IMPROVEMENTS[/h3][list][*] End of dungeon rewards (tiles, perks) can now be chosen in any order
[*] 'Next Dungeon' preview now shows the number of each enemy's count

[h3]NEW[/h3][list][*] Added several new achievements[/list]

[h3]OTHER CHANGES[/h3][list][*] New keyword: Solitary (Replaces text like 'if an enemy is alone in its row')
[*] New keyword: Overwhelm (Triggers its effect if 6 or more enemies are visible on the board)[/list]

[h3]BUGS[/h3][list][*] #486 - Poet now works with [Instant] tiles
[*] #505 - Tapping the 'acquire' button with a full inventory and not enough gold no longer brings up the 'replace tile' screen
[*] Removed 'Intelligent' and 'Adventurer' perks from certain Mutations

notes.title: Rise, Minions!
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/pjVpOB6.png[/img]

[h2]Howdy Muldorf![/h2]
Muldorf - a friendly necromancer and Meteorfall fan favorite - joins the cast of heroes in Krumit's Tale! Like the other heroes, Muldorf plays very differently. In particular, Muldorf summons skeletal minions to do his bidding. He also manipulates his health. Many of Muldorf's items and abilities have different effects at low health, and he also has a bunch of different ways to restore health as well with Lifesteal.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35301153/09b7c12d50d374ce8c6cfead84d623bcff2f97e2.png[/img]

[h2]How do minions work?[/h2]

One of the trickiest parts about the development of Muldorf was figuring out how minions would work. We went through multiple designs before settling on the current design. The key is Muldorf's starting perk, called 'Necrodude'.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/erSpEwJ.png[/img]

Whenever Muldorf slays an enemy, they leave behind a Tombstone. You can pay 3 health to remove the Tombstone from the board and 'summon' a Skeleton minion, which is added to your inventory like an item or ability. 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/aKPFp0Q.png[/img]

The basic Skeleton minion you can summon has 2 attack and 5 health, and can defeat many basic enemies on it's own. When you select a minion, it swaps places with your hero in battle. It deals damage just like your hero, and takes damage in place of your hero. Experienced necromancers will recognize the value of sending it a poor skeleton to take a big hit in their place!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35301153/23a2100208d61f3a04708df678f009d2f51a4830.gif[/img]

Although most of the minions you summon are basic Skeletons, you can also summon Ancient Skeletons and Garbage Golems. It's also possible to buff the attack and health of your minions to make them stronger or more resilient.

[h2]New Boss, New Enemy[/h2]
Besides adding a new hero, this update also adds a new dungeon, The Sanguine Grotto. The Sanguine Grotto features a new boss: Cardoso - a vampire and well-known associate of Muldorf. The dungeon also features the Wasteland Thug, a poisonous new minion that introduces a new 'Wound' mechanic

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35301153/2d9321924f320dc9631779cc74c657904da9c17b.png[/img]

[i]Carodoso and a Wasteland Thug - denizens of the Sanguine Grotto[/i]

[h2]Limited Time Sale![/h2]
This week we're doing a limited time sale in Krumit's Tale, as well as our iOS / Android game, Meteorfall: Journeys. Meteorfall is our first game and takes place in the same universe as Krumit's Tale, featuring many of the same characters. Like Krumit's Tale, it's card-based deck builder roguelite kind of game.

In addition to this release of Krumit's Tale featuring Muldorf and Cardoso, we're releasing an update for Meteorfall that adds Cardoso as an alternate skin for Muldorf, as well as a bunch of new cards, inspired by new abilities we added in Krumit's Tale. If you haven't checked out Meteorfall: Journeys before, this is a great opportunity to pick it up at a discount. Once this discount is over, the price will be increasing again as outlined in our Early Access overview. We've added a ton of new content to this release and we think it justifies the price increase. Buying early is a great way to support the game and get a great deal as well!

Check it out!

[h2]Exclusive Portrait Unlock with Streamer Esty8nine[/h2]
We wanted to do something really fun with content creators to celebrate this new release. We approached Esty8nine, one of the earliest streamers to check out Krumit's Tale. We instantly fell in love with his engaging personality and his supportive fanbase, the Misfits. What better way to honor Esty8nine than by putting him in the game?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35301153/0986944bafe50047718b0e8ac58477a83ae96bd9.png[/img]

Esty8nine is a fantastic streamer that covers mostly indie titles. Most recently, he's been streaming a lot of One Step From Eden & Slay the Spire - titles that fans of Krumit's Tale will no doubt be familiar with.

The only way to get this portrait is to tune into Esty's stream when he streams Krumit's Tale! Esty has a code that he can share with his fans. You can enter that code in-game in order to unlock the portrait. This is a cosmetic reward and won't impact gameplay at all.

We hope you'll love unlocking the portrait and enjoy watching Esty8nine as much we do! Follow Esty8nine on Twitch, Twitter or YouTube to find out when he's streaming Krumit's Tale!

We're not stopping here! We're already hard at work on the next update, will implement Daily Challenges. Daily Challenges present the same dungeon and random choices to all players, providing a fair playing field to compete. Player's will be able to compete for a daily high score and see how they stack up compared to other players. 

Daily Challenges will also feature a set of modifiers that change each day. Sometimes you might have a deck consisting of only treasure chests; other days, you might get a special starting perk or other twist. We think these unique and interesting daily modifiers will help keep the game fresh and interesting, even for veterans of Krumit's Tale.

We anticipate the initial beta release of Daily Challenges will be available in the next couple weeks.

Finally, we've begun prototyping the final hero that we plan to add before exiting Early Access - Rose. Rose is cleric / healer character, with a dangerous dual personality. Although she's best known as a priestess, Rose also dabbles in the dark arts - often with cosmic consequences. Once Rose is polished, we plan to finish the homestretch towards the 1.0 release.

notes.title: Weekly Balance Changes and Fixes
notes.content:
[h3]Balance and Bug Fix Update[/h3]
Last week, we released a patch with a bunch of new tiles for Muldorf. One of those tiles was The Necrotome! - a powerful book that allowed players to draft abilities that buffed their minions. It turned out that the power level of this tile was a bit too strong, and as a result, players were able to easily steamroll dungeons without really trying as Muldorf. This doesn't fit the flavor or theme of Muldorf, and so we've had to reign in the power level of some of these tiles.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35301153/27926598e2197843808d5574de305f1f284b142f.png[/img]

[h3]Bringing Krumit's Tale to More Languages[/h3]
Some of you might have seen our announcement earlier this week about translating Krumit's Tale into more languages. Our goal has always been to make Krumit's Tale to accessible to players around the world, in their own language.

We started with our Simplified Chinese translation a few weeks ago from our publishing partner, Indienova. This week, we're opening up a project on [url=http://localizor.com]Localizor.io[/url]. Localizor.io is a fantastic tool that we love that provides support for community translations of games. Translators earn credit when they translate that can be spent for games. We've already made some great progress on Spanish, German, and Russian, thanks to the amazing support from the Localizor community.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35301153/085b3ec69e8cceed4401e8cf026869f813aec013.png[/img]

[b]How do I get involved?[/b]
If you're interested in getting involved, sign up on Localizor and check out our [url=https://www.localizor.com/game/41/translate]community translation project[/url]. If you're not interested in translating but are fluent in another language, another way you can help is to up vote translations on Localizor. That helps improve the quality of the translations overall and lets us know that we're on the right track.

We've also set up a [url=https://discord.gg/DEJyMGM]#localization channel on our Discord[/url] which you can use to make suggestions or chat with the folks that are helping out with the translations. If you do help out, please make sure to let me know how you'd like to be credited in the credits.

As languages are completed, we'll make an announcement about it on Steam and let players know that the game is now playable in another language.

[i]Note: On the beta branch, the Tier 6 dungeon (2nd boss) is currently locked to the new dungeon, Sanguine Grotto. The following bosses won't randomly show up for the next few weeks, to help ensure more testing on the Sanguine Grotto / Cardoso: Ghost King, Elmer, Itchitah[/i]

[h3]BALANCE[/h3]
[i]We had to make some changes to a set of tiles - Hearty Bones, Soul Feast and The Necrotome! - which made building powerful minions too easy. Part of the issue was that minions, unlike weapons, have no durability. Players also start with Hearty Bones, which provides an easy way to quickly buff minion attack to 4 and snowball from there.

We made getting The Necrotome! a bit more difficult. On top of this, we're swapping the effects of Hearty Bones and Soul Feast. Providing an easy way to buff minion attack in the starting deck makes things a bit too easy. Minions were always meant to be more of an expendable ally for Muldorf - not something that could steamroll the entire game on their own.[/i][list]
[*] HEARTY BONES: No longer increases attack; increases health by 3 (old Soul Feast effect)

notes.title: New hero - Muldorf: Now available on the Beta branch!
notes.content:
[h1]How can I join the beta?[/h1]

Switching to the beta branch is easy!

1. Locate Krumit's Tale in your Steam library list of games
2. Right-click it and select 'Properties'
3. Select the last tab which is "Betas"
4. Choose 'beta' from the dropdown

The game should update automatically at that point. Anyone can opt-in to the beta - no code required.

All of your progress is carried forward to beta. You won't need to grind or unlock previously unlocked content on the beta branch.

It's not recommended to switch back-and-forth between beta and default branch, which may result in data loss or unpredictable results. The reason here is that upgrading to beta will upgrade your save data to the latest version. If you load new save data in a branch that doesn't have those changes, it may behave in unpredictable ways. If you do want to switch back, it's best to wait for the general release of the beta changes. Once that happens, beta and default branch will be in sync, and that would be a safe time to switch back.

[h1]A Review of how Muldorf works[/h1]

One of the trickiest parts about the development of Muldorf was figuring out how minions would work. We went through multiple designs before settling on the current design. The key is Muldorf's starting perk, called 'Necrodude'.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/erSpEwJ.png[/img]

Whenever Muldorf slays an enemy, they leave behind a Tombstone. You can pay 3 health to remove the Tombstone from the board and 'summon' a Skeleton minion, which is added to your inventory like an item or ability. 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/aKPFp0Q.png[/img]

The basic Skeleton minion you can summon has 2 attack and 5 health, and can defeat many basic enemies on it's own. When you select a minion, it swaps places with your hero in battle. It deals damage just like your hero, and takes damage in place of your hero. Experienced necromancers will recognize the value of sending it a poor skeleton to take a big hit in their place!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35301153/23a2100208d61f3a04708df678f009d2f51a4830.gif[/img]

Although most of the minions you summon are basic Skeletons, you can also summon Ancient Skeletons and Garbage Golems. It's also possible to buff the attack and health of your minions to make them stronger or more resilient.

notes.title: Howdy Neighbor!
notes.content:
Hot on the heels of the Mischief release, we're preparing to release Hero #4 - Muldorf - onto the beta branch! Muldorf is a necromancer that summons skeletons to do his bidding and fight for him.

Read on to learn about how Muldorf works in Krumit's Tale, and when he'll be available.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/pjVpOB6.png[/img]

[h2]Howdy, Neighbor![/h2]
Before he known as 'Muldorf Necrodude', he was known as Mulford. Mulford was a fine hero that slay enemies and protected the weak. During one quest, Mulford came across a chest with a bottle labeled 'Finest Dry Gin'. He looked both ways to make sure no one was looking, and then brought bottle to his lips.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/bqnCVCY.jpg[/img]

His eyes grew wide immediately. This was no ordinary bottle of gin. As the potent liquid poured down his throat, Mulford heard the laugh of mischievous djinn cackling in his head. He'd been possessed by a dark djinn - one obsessed with necromancy and blood magic.

Mulford was never quite the same after that. In fact, his mind wasn't the only thing that been in scrambled - he forgot even his own name. On that day he was reborn - as Mulford Necrodude!

As it turns out, Muldorf is quite friendly. He lives in a bustling town and greets his neighbors each morning. Although he dabbles in dark rituals and raising the dead, he's often the life of the party.

[h2]How do minions work?[/h2]

One of the trickiest parts about the development of Muldorf was figuring out how minions would work. We went through multiple designs before settling on the current design. The key is Muldorf's starting perk, called 'Necrodude'.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/erSpEwJ.png[/img]

Whenever Muldorf slays an enemy, they leave behind a Tombstone. You can pay 3 health to remove the Tombstone from the board and 'summon' a Skeleton minion, which is added to your inventory like an item or ability. 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/aKPFp0Q.png[/img]

The basic Skeleton minion you can summon has 2 attack and 5 health, and can defeat many basic enemies on it's own. When you select a minion, it swaps places with your hero in battle. It deals damage just like your hero, and takes damage in place of your hero. Experienced necromancers will recognize the value of sending it a poor skeleton to take a big hit in their place!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35301153/23a2100208d61f3a04708df678f009d2f51a4830.gif[/img]

Although most of the minions you summon are basic Skeletons, you can also summon Ancient Skeletons and Garbage Golems. It's also possible to buff the attack and health of your minions to make them stronger or more resilient.


[h2]When will Muldorf be available?[/h2]
We're finishing up some internal playtesting of Muldorf and plan to release him on the beta branch in the next couple weeks. Anyone that owns Krumit's Tale can easily opt-in to the beta and try him out immediately. We anticipate he'll be on the beta branch for a few weeks so that we can tweak him before releasing to the main branch.

[h2]Fan Art![/h2]
I wanted to feature some fanart as well - I love seeing artists drawing some of the characters of Meteorfall

[img]https://i.imgur.com/mbVW9fS.gif[/img]
This super cute Mischief was drawn by noe @ [url=https://www.reddit.com/r/PortraitProphecies/]/r/PortraitProphecies[/url] and shared in our Discord.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/crlPg7q.png[/img]
A few months ago, FragdPeas [[url=https://www.instagram.com/fragdpeas]Instagram[/url]] posted these great character designs in [url=https://www.reddit.com/r/meteorfall]/r/Meteorfall[/url] - such great characters in the style of Evgeny Viitman!

If you have any fan art you'd like to share, please let me know on Steam, Discord, Reddit, Twitter - wherever - and I'd be glad to share it with the community!

[h2]Price Increase[/h2]
Like with Mischief, we're planning to increase the price of Krumit's Tale as we add new content, and that includes Muldorf. Once Muldorf leaves beta and gets added to the main branch, the price will be increasing again. We'll probably do a small sale right before we raise the price. We anticipate Muldorf will be on the beta branch for a few weeks before merging to the main branch.

[h2]Thank you![/h2]
Thanks again to all the fans and supporters who've submitted countless pieces of feedback and bug reports - Krumit's Tale wouldn't be where it is today without the support of the community. We can't wait to share Muldorf with you in the coming weeks, and we hope you're excited as we are to check him out!

notes.title: Mischief Joins the Fray!
notes.content:
After several months in beta, the newest hero - Mischief, the rogue - is ready to join the battle!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35301153/b836251a9054d63bbefb4b40e60bf3492ffaf9a5.png[/img]

[h3]New mechanic - Stealth[/h3]
Like all good rogues, Mischief prefers to attack from the shadows. Her starting perk - Riff Raff - gives her a -1 base attack bonus, but automatically grants [Stealth] when she attacks an enemy that's alone on its row. While attacking from stealth, Mischief will deal +2 damage (+3 if you have a weapon) and also gain [Blitz] (meaning she'll get to attack first).

Because Mischief has only 1 base attack without stealth, it's imperative to manipulate the board state in order to take advantage of her perk, and to pick off enemies that are alone. Mischief can also use abilities like Knockout, which allow her to shuffle targeted enemies back into the deck - perfect for getting enemies out of the way and setting up a stealth attack.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/UvwJEJM.png[/img]

[h3]More than 40 new items and abilities[/h3]
Mischief features more than 40 new items and abilities! Use new abilities like Heist to steal expensive items without paying the cost, or the Dragorn Fang dagger - a dagger that does tons of extra damage while you're attacking from stealth.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/Gerr3Mj.png[/img]

[h3]Steam Achievements[/h3]
One of the most requested features are Steam Achievements, and we're happy to announce that we've introduced 20 in the Mischief Update! We have plans to add a lot more during Early Access, so stay tuned!
[img]https://i.imgur.com/iLWyooW.png[/img]

[h3]Plus a whole lot more![/h3]
Mischief wasn't the only one who got love in this patch! We've reworked Greybeard's Freeze and Burn mechanics as well. Both have been significantly buffed and tweaked to make playing with the elements a lot more fun. In addition, we added several new perks and items / abilities for both Bruno and Greybeard, to help keep things fresh.

[h3]What's Next?[/h3]
We're already hard at work on Hero #4 and will be sharing more details on the hero soon! One of the design goals in Krumit's Tale is that each hero should feel unique and interesting, and Hero #4 is no exception. Over the next month or so, we'll share more details about the new hero. We plan to follow a similar pattern with Mischief - an open beta for a few weeks, adjusting the hero based on feedback, followed by a main branch release.

[h3]Thank you![/h3]
And finally - a big thank you to all the supportive fans that have helped get Krumit's Tale to where it is today! Your excitement and enthusiasm helps inspire us to go above and beyond, and keeps us motivated through all the tough parts of game development. You are all awesome!

notes.title: The Freeze Update (Beta Branch)
notes.content:
This week primarily brings some *big* changes to how Freeze works. Previously, frozen enemies would deal 1 less damage per attack. It didn't stack, and battles had to last a long time before you could get any real value out of it. Now, freeze lasts only 1 round, but instead, reduces the enemy's attack to 0. This big change makes freeze a lot more powerful, and with careful play, means that you can effectively disable some pretty powerful attacks!

To accommodate such a big change, we reworked a ton of Greybeard's items that add freeze (listed below). Check out the latest changes on the beta branch and let us know what you think on Discord, Reddit or in the Steam forums!

notes.title: The Mischief Update (Beta)
notes.content:
We're really excited for out first big content update and the beta release of Mischief - a sneaky character that uses stealth and poison to bring down big foes!

We've posted instructions on how to switch to the beta branch on the Steam Forums. Check it out if you want to get Mischief early! All data will be carried over - no need to grind or re-unlock anything.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35301153/b836251a9054d63bbefb4b40e60bf3492ffaf9a5.png[/img]

Over the next couple weeks, we'll be fixing bugs and making balance tweaks based on community feedback. The best place to give feedback will be on [url=https://discord.gg/UvTDUqd]Discord[/url] where you can easily file a bug report by typing "!bug" and then the report you want to include. We also actively monitor the Steam forums as well, so if you prefer submitting feedback that way - go for it!

[h3]New mechanic - Stealth[/h3]
Like all good rogues, Mischief prefers to attack from the shadows. Her starting perk - Riff Raff - gives her a -1 base attack bonus, but automatically grants [Stealth] when she attacks an enemy that's alone on its row. While attacking from stealth, Mischief will deal +2 damage (+3 if you have a weapon) and also gain [Blitz] (meaning she'll get to attack first).

Because Mischief has only 1 base attack without stealth, it's imperative to manipulate the board state in order to take advantage of her perk, and to pick off enemies that are alone. Mischief can also use abilities like Knockout, which allow her to shuffle targeted enemies back into the deck - perfect for getting enemies out of the way and setting up a stealth attack.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/UvwJEJM.png[/img]

[h3]More than 40 new items and abilities[/h3]
Mischief features more than 40 new items and abilities! Use new abilities like Heist to steal expensive items without paying the cost, or the Dragorn Fang dagger - a dagger that does tons of extra damage while you're attacking from stealth.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/Gerr3Mj.png[/img]

[h3]Steam Achievements[/h3]
One of the most requested features are Steam Achievements, and we're happy to announce that we've introduced 20 in the Mischief Update! We have plans to add a lot more during Early Access, so stay tuned!
[img]https://i.imgur.com/iLWyooW.png[/img]

[h3]Price increase after beta[/h3]
As mentioned in our Early Access pitch, we plan to increase the price of the game at certain milestones, and this is one of those milestones. Once Mischief leaves beta, the price of the game will increase to $9.99. If you're on the fence or you have friends that are interested, this is a great time to grab a copy - it won't be cheaper than the current price for a long time!

[h3]Thank you![/h3]
And finally - a big thank you to all the supportive fans that have helped get Krumit's Tale to where it is today! Your excitement and enthusiasm helps inspire us to go above and beyond, and keeps us motivated through all the tough parts of game development. You are all awesome!

Besides Steam, you can also discuss Krumit's Tale on [url=https://discord.gg/UvTDUqd]Discord [/url]and Reddit [url=http://www.reddit.com/KrumitsTale]/r//Krumits/Tale[/url]

notes.title: December 14 Bug Fix Update
notes.content:
We're back! The past week has been dedicated primarily to adding new content behind the scenes for Mischief, as well as preparing for localization into other languages.

Mischief has been coming along great so far, and we're constantly iterating over her design and playtesting to make sure she's as fun and unique as Bruno and Greybeard. Mischief starts off with an interesting perk called 'Riff-raff' which reads "-1 Base attack. When you attack an enemy that's alone in its row, gain [Stealth]". Stealth is a new keyword that reads 'Your next attack has [Blitz] and does +2 damage (+3 if you have a weapon". The result is that Mischief cares *a lot* about the positioning of enemies. She's weak on her own with a base attack of just 1 damage, but she can easily pick off enemies that are alone in their row. She also has abilities like Knockout which allow you to shuffle an enemy back into the deck - useful when there are 2 enemies in a row and you need to isolate an enemy so that you can gain Stealth.

We'll continue to iterate on Mischief over the next several weeks as we prepare to release her. The current plan is that once she feels like she's in a good place, we'll put her on the Beta branch and gather feedback from players before moving her to the main branch. I'm super excited to introduce her to everyone!

notes.title: Nov 20 Weekly Update
notes.content:
We've been hard at work on the next bug fix update for Krumit's Tale!  This is a pretty big bug fix, with many issues fixed - a big thank you to the community for continuing to report issues, and helping us make Krumit's Tale as great as possible!

[h1]NOTABLE CHANGES[/h1]
[b]Flat gem reward at end of dungeon reduced from 20 to 5[/b] We found, while watching players stream, that gems were too plentiful, making buying decisions at the shop too easy.  Decreasing the flat gem bonus for completing a level (while keeping the 'unused item bonus') makes shop purchases more thoughtful.

[b]HAMSTRING[/b]: Now reads "Once per battle, activate this to cancel an enemy's non-attack action" (used to only affect Blitz actions)
[i]This card felt too situational before, and this change should make the card more useful[/i]

[b]MIGHTY SWING[/b]: Now reads "Increase your attack by an amount equal to your equipped melee weapons. Recharges after 6 rounds of combat" 
[i]This card didn't really feel impactful, and the fact that it exhausted made it pretty much only useful against bosses.  The new design is something that can be used to much greater effect.[/i]

[b]MYSTIC EYEPATCH[/b]: Now reads "When this tile is added to the dungeon, reduce the cost of abilities in the same column by 2"
[i]The original design for this ability (reduce 1 cost abilities to 0) didn't have a very powerful effect, and the new ability is more versatile / interesting[/i]

[b]POET[/b]: Now only clones abilities acquired if they are in the *bottom* row
[i]This perk proved to be too powerful and was basically an auto-pick for Greybeard.  This change makes the effect slightly more difficult to use, and requires more preparation in order to take full advantage.[/i]

notes.title: The 'Git Gud' Update
notes.content:
Testers have been doing a great job tearing through the content in Krumit's Tale and I decided it would be worth focusing on some more challenging content to keep the experienced players engaged.

Like Meteorfall, Krumit's Tale features a similar New Game+ system - beating the game once unlocks a 'New Game+' mode which adds a difficulty modifier to the run.  In the case of the first level, it's pretty minor - your max health is reduced by 2.  If you beat that level, Krumit tacks on another modifier *on top of* the original modifier - now shop items are more expensive.  My favorite modifier so far is one that adds 'curses' to your deck - negative abilities that have an effect while on the board and cost health to remove.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35301153/c5f46127b19b061fd5d049cd35916868f45a7bdb.png[/img]

I decided to put this feature on the 'beta' branch instead of the general release because it may not be as stable as the current default branch.  Even more so than other content in Krumit's Tale, this new difficulty mode is much more likely to change (even significantly).  Difficulty modifiers might be moved around, added, removed - or maybe the whole system will be overhauled.

I'd love to get some feedback on how far up players can get, and if there are any hard blocks for either hero.  I've tested up to NG+ 5 or so, and can barely scrape by.  By far, the modifier I've had the most trouble with is the one that increases enemy HP by just 1 point - it throws off all of your muscle memory.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35301153/b1ae499436128cf02920cdaeece55004bd4c59e9.png[/img]

To switch to the beta branch, it's fairly easy - I'll link to this really helpful support article from Klei (Oxygen Not Included) http://support.kleientertainment.com/customer/en/portal/articles/2776550-how-to-change-branches-in-oxygen-not-included-steam-.  Basically, you just need to right-click Krumit's Tale in your Steam library and go to the 'Beta' tab.

Just a warning that the beta branch is going to be inherently less stable than the main branch, so use at your own risk!  If you ever feel it's too unstable and you prefer to go back to the default branch, you can do that the same way as switching to the beta branch.

Thanks, and can't wait to hear how everyone enjoys the new mode!

Note - If you've beaten the game before, you'll need to do it again with this new update in order to unlock NG+
